description: List password entries, optionally filtered by folder_id and/or tag. Sorted by title (case-insensitive).

folder_id.description: Optional folder identifier to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of entry summaries {entid, title, username, url, folder_id, tags, strength, last_used_at}.

description: Retrieve a single vault entry by entid. Password field is always returned masked (first char + '*'*len + last char).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full entry record with password_masked (never plaintext).

description: Create a new password entry. Plaintext password is accepted but only stored as first_char + '*' * (len-2) + last_char; strength is auto-computed by length.

password.description: Plaintext password; stored only in masked form.

folder_id.description: Folder to add the entry to (default fd_personal).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new entry summary.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing entry. If password is supplied, it is masked and strength is re-computed.

folder_id.description: Optional folder to move the entry into.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated entry summary.

description: Delete a vault entry permanently. Any shares of this entry are also revoked.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {entid, deleted: true, removed_shares}.

description: Simulate copying the masked password to clipboard. Updates last_used_at and appends an audit log.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {entid, password_masked, copied_at}.

description: Mark an entry as used right now (updates last_used_at) without copying the password.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {entid, last_used_at}.

description: List all folders in the vault.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {fdid, name, color}.

description: Create a new folder for organizing entries.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new {fdid, name, color}.

description: Delete a folder. Entries in the folder are reassigned (to fd_personal if it exists, otherwise the first remaining folder). At least one folder must remain.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {fdid, moved, reassigned_to}.

description: List shares, optionally filtered by entry_id. Sorted by shared_at ascending.

entry_id.description: Optional entry identifier to filter shares by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of share records {shid, entry_id, shared_with, shared_at, expires_at, can_edit}.

description: Share an entry with another user identifier (email or user id) with optional expiry and edit permission.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO datetime after which the share expires.

can_edit.description: Whether the recipient can edit the entry.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new share record.

description: Revoke an existing share by shid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {shid, revoked: true}.

description: List audit log events, optionally filtered by entry_id. Sorted by timestamp descending (most recent first).

entry_id.description: Optional entry identifier to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of audit records {audit_id, action, entry_id, actor, timestamp}.

description: Search entries by keyword across title, username, url, notes, and tags.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching entry summaries sorted by title.

description: Return vault-wide statistics: totals for entries, folders, shares, audit logs, plus counts by folder and by password strength.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {total_entries, total_folders, total_shares, total_audit_logs, by_folder, by_strength}.
